subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation accept the global browser SSRF private-network opt-in as well as the provider-scoped models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork setting?
rationale: Both settings intentionally widen an SSRF boundary, and source/tests cannot determine whether the browser-wide policy is an approved authorization source for this provider.

options.title: Approve both opt-ins
options.body: Keep the current architecture so either the established global SSRF policy or sanitized xAI provider request setting can authorize the private endpoint.

options.title: Require provider-scoped opt-in
options.body: Remove the browser-policy override and authorize private xAI image requests only through the xAI provider request setting.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Leave xAI image generation fail-closed until maintainers define a uniform private-network policy for image providers.

recommendation.title: Approve both opt-ins
recommendation.body: Keep the current architecture so either the established global SSRF policy or sanitized xAI provider request setting can authorize the private endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history most directly owns the xAI image-generation feature whose authorization contract is changing.
